mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, department_id AS departmentId, name, title, introduction, registration_fee AS registrationFee, status, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_doctor ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, department_id AS departmentId, name, title, introduction, registration_fee AS registrationFee, status, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_doctor WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_doctor ( user_id, department_id, name, title, introduction, registration_fee, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{departmentId}, #{name}, #{title}, #{introduction}, #{registrationFee}, #{status} )
